title: Naturally Smoky Australian Red Peppers Skewers
description: Charred and aerated, these skewers are a crowd-pleaser featuring sweet red peppers in a sugar-free friendly mother sauce base, inspired by Australian cuisine. This dish is perfect for outdoor gatherings and barbecues.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the red peppers into 1-inch pieces and thread them onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, tomato paste, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to make the mother sauce.
Brush the skewers with the mother sauce, making sure each piece of pepper is well coated.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the peppers are charred and tender.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
